title: Bounds of triangular subnorms and their algorithms
summary: This article deals with the upper and lower bounds of triangular subnorms generated by continuous, strictly decreasing additive generators. It first establishes necessary and sufficient conditions for the comparability of such triangular subnorms. It then explores the existence of strict (resp. nilpotent) bounds of a finite family of strict (resp. nilpotent) triangular subnorms generated by continuous, strictly decreasing additive generators.
